    return value & (SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY - 1U);

static void add_saturating(size_t *target, size_t amount)
{
    if (amount > SIZE_MAX - *target) {
        *target = SIZE_MAX;
        current.overflow = true;
    } else {
        *target += amount;
    }
}

static size_t find_record(void *pointer, bool insertion)
{
    if (pointer == NULL) return SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY;
    size_t slot = pointer_hash(pointer), deleted = SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY;
    for (size_t probes = 0U; probes < SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY; ++probes) {
        svg_alloc_record *record = &records[slot];
        if (record->state == 0U)
            return insertion && deleted != SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY ?
                deleted : slot;
        if (record->state == 2U) {
            if (deleted == SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY) deleted = slot;
        } else if (record->pointer == pointer) {
            return slot;
        }
        slot = (slot + 1U) & (SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY - 1U);
    }
    return insertion ? deleted : SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY;
}

static void track_add(void *pointer, size_t size)
{
    if (!active || pointer == NULL) return;
    size_t slot = find_record(pointer, true);
    if (slot == SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY) {
        current.overflow = true;
        return;
    }
    svg_alloc_record *record = &records[slot];
    if (record->state == 1U) {
        if (record->size <= current.live_bytes)
            current.live_bytes -= record->size;
        else
            current.live_bytes = 0U;
    }
    *record = (svg_alloc_record){pointer, size, SVG_SHAPE_ALLOC_TAG_NONE, 1U};
    add_saturating(&current.total_allocated_bytes, size);
    add_saturating(&current.allocation_count, 1U);
    add_saturating(&current.live_bytes, size);
    if (current.live_bytes > current.peak_live_bytes)
        current.peak_live_bytes = current.live_bytes;
}

static void track_remove(void *pointer)
{
    if (!active || pointer == NULL) return;
    size_t slot = find_record(pointer, false);
    if (slot == SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY) return;
    svg_alloc_record *record = &records[slot];
    if (record->size <= current.live_bytes)
        current.live_bytes -= record->size;
    else {
        current.live_bytes = 0U;
        current.overflow = true;
    }
    record->pointer = NULL;
    record->size = 0U;
    record->tag = SVG_SHAPE_ALLOC_TAG_NONE;
    record->state = 2U;
}

void svg_shape_alloc_tracking_stop(svg_shape_alloc_stats *stats)

    active = false;

    if (size == 0U || count <= SIZE_MAX / size) bytes = count * size;
    else current.overflow = true;
    track_add(pointer, bytes);
    return pointer;
}

void *svg_shape_realloc(void *pointer, size_t size)
{
    if (!active) return realloc(pointer, size);
    size_t previous_size = 0U;
    size_t previous_slot = find_record(pointer, false);
    bool tracked = previous_slot != SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY;

    if (tracked) track_remove(pointer);
    track_add(grown, size);
    (void)previous_size;
    return grown;
}

void svg_shape_free(void *pointer)

    track_remove(pointer);
    free(pointer);
}

bool svg_shape_alloc_set_tag(void *pointer, svg_shape_alloc_tag tag)

    record->tag = tag;
    return true;

use std::sync::Arc;
use vexel_scene::{
    AllocationLease, AllocationTag, ChargeLedger, Diagnostic, ErrorKind, LimitKind, Result,
};

/// Historical maximum number of simultaneously tracked allocation records.
pub const SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY: usize = 65_536;

fn arithmetic() -> Diagnostic {
    Diagnostic {
        kind: ErrorKind::Limit(LimitKind::Arithmetic),
        offset: 0,
    }
}
#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct MemoryStats {
    pub source_bytes: usize,
    pub peak_live_bytes: usize,
    pub live_bytes: usize,
    pub total_allocated_bytes: usize,
    pub allocation_count: usize,
    pub token_array_bytes: usize,
    pub reference_index_bytes: usize,
    pub clip_copy_bytes: usize,
    pub output_bytes: usize,
    pub overflow: bool,
}

/// Per-job admission scope. The shared ledger remains the only lease registry; this stores
/// just an active-count bound and an unforgeable shared owner token.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct AllocationTracking {
    owner: Arc<()>,
    active: usize,
}
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct TrackedAllocationLease {
    owner: Arc<()>,
    lease: AllocationLease,
}

impl AllocationTracking {
    pub fn tracking_start(job: &ChargeLedger) -> Self {
        let _ = job;
        Self {
            owner: Arc::new(()),
            active: 0,
        }
    }
    pub fn track_capacity<T>(
        &mut self,
        job: &mut ChargeLedger,
        tag: AllocationTag,
        values: &Vec<T>,
    ) -> Result<TrackedAllocationLease> {
        if self.active >= SVG_ALLOC_TRACKER_CAPACITY {
            return Err(Diagnostic {
                kind: ErrorKind::Limit(LimitKind::Nodes),
                offset: 0,
            });
        }
        let active = self.active.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(arithmetic)?;
        let lease = job.admit_vec(tag, values)?;
        self.active = active;
        Ok(TrackedAllocationLease {
            owner: self.owner.clone(),
            lease,
        })
    }
    pub fn release(
        &mut self,
        job: &mut ChargeLedger,
        lease: &TrackedAllocationLease,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        if !Arc::ptr_eq(&self.owner, &lease.owner) {
            return Err(Diagnostic {
                kind: ErrorKind::InvalidArgument,
                offset: 0,
            });
        }
        let active = self.active.checked_sub(1).ok_or_else(arithmetic)?;
        job.release(lease.lease)?;
        self.active = active;
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn tracking_stop(&self, job: &ChargeLedger) -> MemoryStats {
        let ledger = job.stats();
        MemoryStats {
            source_bytes: ledger.source_bytes,
            peak_live_bytes: ledger.peak_live_bytes,
            live_bytes: ledger.live_bytes,
            total_allocated_bytes: ledger.total_allocated_bytes,
            allocation_count: ledger.allocation_count,
            token_array_bytes: ledger.token_array_bytes,
            reference_index_bytes: ledger.reference_index_bytes,
            clip_copy_bytes: ledger.clip_copy_bytes,
            output_bytes: ledger.output_bytes,
            overflow: ledger.overflow,
        }
    }
}

/// Reserve into a fresh buffer, charge its actual capacity while the old buffer remains
/// live, then transfer values and publish. Before calling, the caller must have an active
/// ledger lease for current Vec capacity; release that old lease after return, when the old
/// allocation is dropped. `None` means the existing charged capacity already suffices.
pub fn reserve_table<T>(
    job: &mut ChargeLedger,
    tag: AllocationTag,
    table: &mut Vec<T>,
    additional: usize,
) -> Result<Option<AllocationLease>> {
    let required = table.len().checked_add(additional).ok_or_else(arithmetic)?;
    required
        .checked_mul(std::mem::size_of::<T>())
        .ok_or_else(arithmetic)?;
    if required <= table.capacity() {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let mut replacement = Vec::new();
    replacement
        .try_reserve_exact(required)
        .map_err(|_| Diagnostic {
            kind: ErrorKind::OutOfMemory,
            offset: 0,
        })?;
    let actual = replacement
        .capacity()
        .checked_mul(std::mem::size_of::<T>())
        .ok_or_else(arithmetic)?;
    let lease = job.admit(tag, actual)?;
    replacement.append(table);
    std::mem::swap(table, &mut replacement);
    Ok(Some(lease))
}

struct Entry {

pub struct ChargeLedger {
    source: SourceOwner,
    owner: u64,
    next: u64,
    max_leases: usize,
    reserved_bytes: usize,
    per_tag: [usize; 5],
    entries: Vec<Entry>,
    free: Option<usize>,
    stats: RenderMemoryStats,
    pub work: RenderWorkStats,
}
impl ChargeLedger {
    pub fn new(source: &SourceOwner, reserved_bytes: usize, max_leases: usize) -> Result<Self> {
        if source.len() > 1 << 30 {
            return Err(limit(LimitKind::SourceBytes));
        }
        if source.capacity() > reserved_bytes {
            return Err(limit(LimitKind::ReservedBytes));
        }
        let owner = NEXT_LEDGER
            .try_update(Ordering::Relaxed, Ordering::Relaxed, |v| v.checked_add(1))
            .map_err(|_| arithmetic())?;
        let source_bytes = source.capacity();
        Ok(Self {
            source: source.clone(),
            owner,
            next: 1,
            max_leases,
            reserved_bytes,
            per_tag: [0; 5],
            entries: Vec::new(),
            free: None,
            stats: RenderMemoryStats {
                live_bytes: source_bytes,
                peak_live_bytes: source_bytes,
                source_bytes,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            work: Default::default(),
        })
    }
    pub fn source_owner(&self) -> &SourceOwner {
        &self.source
    }
    pub fn available(&self) -> usize {
        self.reserved_bytes - self.stats.live_bytes
    }
    pub fn stats(&self) -> RenderMemoryStats {
        let mut s = self.stats;
        s.token_array_bytes = self.per_tag[1];
        s.reference_index_bytes = self.per_tag[2];
        s.clip_copy_bytes = self.per_tag[3];
        s.output_bytes = self.per_tag[4];
        s
    }
    /// Capacity supplied by an actual Vec, not logical element count.
    pub fn admit_vec<T>(&mut self, tag: AllocationTag, values: &Vec<T>) -> Result<AllocationLease> {
        self.admit(tag, bytes(values)?)
    }
    /// Aggregate nested capacity computed by the full owning module (e.g. scratch).
    /// Callers retain the buffer and release its lease at the same lifetime boundary.
    pub fn admit(&mut self, tag: AllocationTag, amount: usize) -> Result<AllocationLease> {
        match self.admit_inner(tag, amount) {
            Err(error) if error.kind == ErrorKind::Limit(LimitKind::Arithmetic) => {
                self.stats.overflow = true;
                Err(error)
            }
            result => result,
        }
    }
    fn admit_inner(&mut self, tag: AllocationTag, amount: usize) -> Result<AllocationLease> {
        let next = self.next.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(arithmetic)?;
        let count = self
            .stats
            .allocation_count
            .checked_add(usize::from(amount != 0))
            .ok_or_else(arithmetic)?;
        let tagged = add(self.per_tag[tag as usize], amount)?;
        let history = add(self.stats.total_allocated_bytes, amount)?;
        let total = add(self.stats.live_bytes, amount)?;
        let overlap = self
            .reserved_bytes
            .checked_sub(total)
            .ok_or_else(|| limit(LimitKind::ReservedBytes))?;
        if self.free.is_none() {
            count.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(arithmetic)?;
            let (new, old) = reserve(
                &mut self.entries,
                1,
                self.max_leases,
                overlap.min(usize::MAX - history),
            )?;
            if new != 0 {
                let current = add(total, new)?;
                let new_history = add(history, new)?;
                let new_count = count.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(arithmetic)?;
                self.stats.peak_live_bytes = self.stats.peak_live_bytes.max(current);
                self.stats.live_bytes = add(self.stats.live_bytes - old, new)?;
                self.per_tag[0] = add(self.per_tag[0] - old, new)?;
                self.stats.total_allocated_bytes = new_history - amount;
                self.stats.allocation_count = new_count - usize::from(amount != 0);
            }
        }
        // Recalculate after registry growth. Metadata is itself retained and charged.
        let current = add(self.stats.live_bytes, amount)?;
        if current > self.reserved_bytes {
            return Err(limit(LimitKind::ReservedBytes));
        }
        let serial = self.next;
        self.next = next;
        let slot = if let Some(slot) = self.free {
            self.free = self.entries[slot].next_free;
            slot
        } else {
            self.entries.len()
        };
        let entry = Entry {
            serial,
            tag,
            bytes: amount,
            active: true,
            next_free: None,
        };
        if slot == self.entries.len() {
            self.entries.push(entry);
        } else {
            self.entries[slot] = entry;
        }
        self.per_tag[tag as usize] = if tag == AllocationTag::None {
            add(self.per_tag[0], amount)?
        } else {
            tagged
        };
        self.stats.live_bytes = current;
        self.stats.peak_live_bytes = self.stats.peak_live_bytes.max(current);
        self.stats.total_allocated_bytes = add(self.stats.total_allocated_bytes, amount)?;
        self.stats.allocation_count = self
            .stats
            .allocation_count
            .checked_add(usize::from(amount != 0))
            .ok_or_else(arithmetic)?;

item.text: The blocker is in the public replacement path, so I’m tracing the current ledger contract and all owned allocation APIs before changing signatures. The key constraint is whether the accepted ledger exposes a reversible reservation or lease identity check; that determines how to enforce failure-history and wrong-job guarantees without editing shared code.

The shared ledger has `available()` and exclusive `&mut ChargeLedger` access, but no reversible reservation, transaction, or public ledger identity check. I can close the 65,536 bypass by making replacement operate only on a tracker-owned buffer, account the overlap, and use `available()` as a failure-safe preflight before `try_reserve_exact`; a failed physical reserve then leaves ledger history untouched. Same-source but different-ledger identity cannot be checked preemptively with the accepted API, so I’m keeping buffer ownership opaque and will report that exact remaining contract gap if no safe local proof exists.

# Candidate result

Implemented the complete owned selection and allocation-query algorithms against accepted scene APIs. Query handle resolution now uses `SceneView::shape_id(index)`, including empty records, and preserves generation, scene, and owner guards. Bounds/source queries and hit testing have controlled variants; variable shape/edge scans charge shared work control and propagate cancellation. Hit testing preserves reverse painter order, edge-color/image visibility, nonzero/even-odd fill, clip-provider calls, inverse-space stroke distance, open-subpath edge exclusion, and tolerance scaling.

Source assignment is an append-time `ShapeInput` operation because published scene data is immutable. Allocation tracking uses actual Vec capacities and shared `ChargeLedger` leases. Replacement admission requires an active old-capacity lease, charges the new capacity while overlap exists, and returns its lease for caller-managed lifetime release. No raw allocator or RSS claim is made.

Tests build a real sealed graph using the seeded lexical, SVG path, and animation APIs. They cover zero-edge handles, stale/foreign IDs, bounds, source specificity, reverse painter order, clip gating, even-odd fill, stroke closure/inverse/tolerance, invalid coordinates, cancellation, capacity overlap/release, budget rejection, arithmetic overflow, and the original fixture source bytes.

The original `measure_allocation_source` integration assertions remain preserved but unexecuted until concrete decoder/reference-index, clip-copy, and raster-output composition is available. **Candidate updated.** Replacement buffers now stay inside an opaque `TrackedBuffer`; the tracker counts old and new capacities during overlap, enforces the 65,536-record limit, and rejects wrong-source, wrong-ledger, foreign-scope, stale, and duplicate releases. Budget failure preserves the old values and allocation history. The original nine meaningful proofs remain, with three allocation cases added.

Scoped check, tests, and work-order validation passed. The allocation suite now has eight tests; all 12 integration tests passed. Reports cover all 8 selection and 14 allocation symbols in [parity-map.json](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.cache/WO-RUST-SCENE-QUERY-01/worker/artifacts/WO-RUST-SCENE-QUERY-01/parity-map.json).

**Shared API blocker:** `ChargeLedger` has no transactional reservation with history rollback. The implementation preflights available bytes, performs the fallible physical reserve, then admits actual capacity before publishing. That preserves history if physical reservation fails, but strict lease admission before allocation with rollback on failure requires a coordinator-owned shared API change. This remains a candidate for independent review, not an accepted result.

The original mixed decode/render allocation assertions remain preserved but unexecuted pending renderer adapters. Full app/runtime and release checks also remain later gates.
